entries.title: One Primary CTA Per Fold & Clear Visual Hierarchy
entries.summary: Focus reader attention on one primary action per fold while demoting competing buttons to secondary or link variants.
rules: Limit each hero or conversion fold to 1 primary CTA button; demote extra primary buttons to secondary.
Use specific, outcome-driven CTA labels ('Claim Book 1 ($2.99)' or 'Order Direct Paperback ($14.99)') instead of vague verbs.
Keep body copy measure between 60ch and 65ch via live design tokens when available, and align padding/gaps to the 8pt spacing scale.

entries.title: Four-Beat Book Blurb & Direct-to-Reader Funnel Copy
entries.summary: Convert cold browsers into series binge-readers using a four-paragraph hook-stakes-collision-ultimatum blurb and clear price-tier framing.
rules: Open Paragraph 1 with a 12-to-20-word punchy tagline hook establishing betrayal, urgency, or forbidden alliance.
Introduce protagonist stakes in Paragraph 2, counterpart collision in Paragraph 3, and a binary ultimatum + next-step CTA in Paragraph 4.
Anchor direct-to-reader value clearly alongside eBook ($2.99 / $4.99), bundle ($12.99), and paperback ($14.99 / $16.99) tiers.
citations: Plotific Press Commercial Fiction Funnel Guide
